command:
set -eu
boot=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)
[ "$boot" != 15e107d8-0ed1-4e5e-83d8-b27c8a49d853 ]
[ "$(cat /sys/block/mmcblk0/device/cid)" = 275048534436344760702d33e0017c00 ]
[ "$(uname -r)" = 6.12.11-fes-de25-owner ]
echo "$boot"
sha256sum /sys/kernel/notes /usr/share/fes/kernel-modules.json
ls -ln /dev/fes-de25-scanout
[ ! -e /tmp/fes-de25-shared-lifecycle-1cf ]
[ ! -e /lib/firmware/fes-runtime-core.rbf ]
[ ! -d /sys/kernel/config/device-tree/overlays/fes-runtime ]
cat /sys/class/net/eth0/addr_assign_type
cat /sys/class/net/eth0/address
cat /etc/network/interfaces
echo SHARED_LIFECYCLE_SOFTWARE_REBOOT_RETURNED
